summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to make 501(c)(3) organizations criminally and civilly liable for certain activities, including terrorism or interfering with constitutional rights or commerce, if those activities are related to funds they provide as a fiscal sponsor.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to impose liability on 501(c)(3) organizations acting as fiscal sponsors for certain activities. While it modifies tax law, it does not directly change tax rates or create new taxes, nor does it offer tax breaks. Its primary effect is on the responsibilities of tax-exempt organizations, not on the overall level of taxation.
